OAT-03/S29.title: A failed Regenerate keeps today's note and the added dictation; yesterday's note never shows as today's (both contexts)
OAT-03/S29.detail: Our addition (review TFA-94422): record bar is 'physician loses data or sees a wrong note'. rst-oat03-s29-regenerate-fail.spec.ts, local, mocked model, procedure-other template (no billing job; the seeded NH yesterday-note is typed procedure-other with a stored suggestion, checked: no job). (a) N1 generated with the mocked model, then ' QA OAT-03 regenerate line: plan unchanged.' appended and Regenerate Note answered with a failure: explicit failure; the box and the server keep the dictation with the appended line; the stored note still equals N1 and Post-Round shows N1. (b) Hospital: a previousNotes entry 20 h old with 'QA OAT-03 yesterday marker: started cefazolin.'; Nursing Home: a note generated 20 h ago (the first page load moved it to previousNotes, dated Oct 15); today's first Generate fails -> Post-Round shows 'No note generated yet', the marker is not under today's note heading. Each context 10/10 judged (setup checks included). Recorded: the failure copy does not claim N1 was replaced (Q3); the Pre-Round tab did not show yesterday's note text (the panel is collapsed). Tripwire: no model call.
